template_name: Retrieve & Restore · 开盒取物复原

review.original_instruction: Open the storage box by parking its lid on lid_pad. Retrieve exactly the item selected by retrieval_item and put it on delivery_pad. Then replace the lid to close the box. Leave the unselected item inside. The selected item is initially unspecified. Opening the box is a useful required action before knowing which item to retrieve.

interaction.message: NoAsk 按定义不提问；不会出现回答表单。 结束时仍有未公开偏好，执行可能使用了猜测；成功与否由真实物理结果评分。

ground_truth.meaning: 自动用户按预置隐藏偏好回答；评分目标固定。
